It was great to meet you at the SEO Career Summit in New York. We talked about the grocery chain turnaround you worked on, and your point that consumer deals come down to repeat customers is how I now think about consumer and retail M&A, the part of finance that draws me most.

Marcus Delacroix suggested I write to you, since the consumer team runs the sophomore program and hires from it. My name is Maya Okafor, and I'm a sophomore at Duke University graduating in 2029, also from Atlanta. This summer I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks as an intern at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, and I'm a consumer sector analyst in Duke Investment Club.

I have two questions. First, when does the sophomore program open? Second, does it feed into the summer analyst class?

My resume is attached in case it helps with either answer. Thank you for your time!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
maya.okafor@duke.edu
(919) 555-0142
